summary: Oneida County, WI conservation tower over a 1940 survey mark south of Monico, standing by 1952; now listed as gone, though a 2010 map still labels it.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone with no removal date; the latest mention is a 2010 map label

events.note: A 1952 recovery note says a Wisconsin Conservation lookout tower stood over the station mark; the build date is not given
A USGS topo map published in 2010 labels a Beck Lookout Tower; the label alone does not show a standing tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county list marks the tower gone, but a 2010 map label still names a Beck Lookout Tower. A label does not show that a tower stood there that year, so the status stays gone and no removal date is given.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a 1952 recovery note quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, the county status listing, and a 2010 map label. The Pastmaps page is an automatically written summary of the map, so the 2010 label is the weakest evidence. The anyplaceamerica.com page returned HTTP 403. A Wisconsin Historical Society Facebook post mentions a 1935 CCC move of a lookout tower, but the page would not load and it is unclear whether it concerns Beck, so it is not used. Worth checking Oneida County or Wisconsin DNR records for a removal date. Used two WebSearch calls and about five page reads.
